contractChecks.explicitSelection: No --sdk-source preserves original plan pin, original receipt shape and original acquisition/materialization guards. Alternate is never an implicit fallback.
contractChecks.immutableAlternate: Fixed code constants and exact typed JSON jointly bind baseline plan SHA256, original compressed TAR SHA256, Runtime ref, producer job, new artifact/run/attempt, ZIP/TAR pins and raw TAR anchor; duplicate/unknown keys and bool-as-int identities reject.
contractChecks.normalProvenance: Official fixed-repository metadata requires matching artifact/run/size/digest, completed source/head/attempt, successful exact SDK producer job/run/attempt/name and unexpired artifact. Source run overall failure is distinguished from SDK producer success.
contractChecks.wireVsContent: New ZIP and compressed TAR hashes remain different and are recorded honestly. Both original and new compressed streams expand to the identical complete TAR bytes, including header metadata, validated independently and pinned at runtime.
contractChecks.runtimeIntegrity: Fetch verifies new ZIP size/hash/CRC/layout, compressed TAR size/hash and bounded full raw TAR hash before success receipt. Materialize revalidates trusted receipt, compressed and raw TAR hashes, canonical tree and SDK version before use.
contractChecks.consistentOptIn: Pipeline forwards the explicit source to materialize; census --verify-sdk uses the same source loader and receipt validator. A source supplied without SDK verification is rejected in census mode.
contractChecks.receiptAuthority: Receipt cannot choose its own identity or hashes; validation compares exact recursive shape/type/value to freshly built trusted data.
contractChecks.publicEvidence: Alternate SDK evidence identifies actual artifact/run/attempt/ZIP/TAR, source JSON digest, raw TAR anchor and original content baseline separately. Invalid/missing acquisition evidence fails without substituting the historical source.
contractChecks.checkpointCompatibility: Plan bytes/context comparisons, SDK reference mode/content comparison, typed roots, archive integrity, replay origin and actual effective configuration guards remain unchanged. No manifest or actual GITHUB environment rewrite.
contractChecks.deadlinesAndPrivileges: Existing 600-second payload download check, 12-minute workflow SDK step requirement, resource monitoring/cleanup and finite phase/job limits remain required; no new privilege, signing, retention or authentication scope.
contractChecks.postAcquisitionExpiry: Legitimately acquired verified local SDK can materialize after later service expiry; no additional network retrieval is needed or permitted by that fact.
